name: two_stage_quarterly_dividend_rate_conversion_para
question_template: A company pays dividends every quarter; the one just paid was {D0} USD per share. Stage one covers {N_Q} quarters, during which every quarterly dividend exceeds the preceding one by {G1_BP} basis points (a basis point is 0.01 percent; a negative figure means a cut), so the quarter-1 dividend already reflects one quarter of growth. Once stage one ends, dividends rise at {G2_PCT} percent a year in perpetuity, turned into a quarterly growth rate by the {CONV} convention: 'compound' uses the rate that, compounded across four quarters, yields the annual rate, and 'nominal' divides the annual percentage by four. Investors require an effective annual return of {R_EFF} percent; translate it into the equivalent compounded quarterly rate and discount every quarterly dividend at that rate. The terminal value at the close of the final stage-one quarter is the first stage-two dividend divided by the quarterly rate minus the quarterly stage-two growth; no valuation exists unless that growth is lower than the quarterly rate. Give the quarterly discount rate in percent, the present value of the stage-one dividends, the terminal value at the end of stage one, and today's share price (stage-one present value plus discounted terminal value).

slots.description: Quarterly discount rate equivalent to the effective annual required return, in percent
Present value today of all stage-one quarterly dividends per share
Terminal value per share at the end of the last stage-one quarter

program:
from fractions import Fraction
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext

def to_dec(x):
    f = Fraction(x)
    return Decimal(f.numerator) / Decimal(f.denominator)

def solve():
    getcontext().prec = 60
    d0 = to_dec(P["D0"])
    g1_bp = to_dec(P["G1_BP"])
    n_q = int(P["N_Q"])
    g2_pct = to_dec(P["G2_PCT"])
    r_eff = to_dec(P["R_EFF"])
    conv = P["CONV"]
    one = Decimal(1)
    # stage-one quarterly growth from basis points
    g1q = g1_bp / Decimal(10000)
    # quarterly discount rate equivalent to effective annual rate
    rq = (one + r_eff / Decimal(100)).sqrt().sqrt() - one
    # stage-two quarterly growth
    if conv == "compound":
        g2q = (one + g2_pct / Decimal(100)).sqrt().sqrt() - one
    elif conv == "nominal":
        g2q = g2_pct / Decimal(400)
    else:
        raise ValueError("unknown conversion convention")
    if g2q >= rq:
        raise ValueError("quarterly stage-two growth must be below quarterly discount rate")
    pv1 = Decimal(0)
    div = d0
    for t in range(1, n_q + 1):
        div = div * (one + g1q)
        pv1 += div / (one + rq) ** t
    d_last = div
    tv = d_last * (one + g2q) / (rq - g2q)
    price = pv1 + tv / (one + rq) ** n_q
    return {
        "final": price,
        "quarterly_rate": rq * Decimal(100),
        "stage_one_pv": pv1,
        "terminal_value": tv,
    }
